profiles.name: Lipinski
profiles.notes: Rule of Five. Ships with the classical policy (one violation tolerated); switch pass_policy to {"type": "all_rules"} for the strict reading. The rule indicates a higher chance of absorption or permeation problems beyond these limits; it does not assert that every molecule inside them is an oral drug. LogP here is the Wildman-Crippen estimate, not ClogP or MLOGP.

profiles.name: Veber
profiles.notes: Complements Lipinski with molecular flexibility and polar surface area. The original study associated these two criteria with a higher probability of good oral bioavailability in its own experimental set.

profiles.name: Lead-like
profiles.notes: Chemical space: lead-like. Purpose: selecting starting points for optimisation, i.e. structures smaller and less lipophilic than a finished drug, leaving room for molecular growth. Present this separately from the oral-drug filters.

profiles.name: Rule of Three — Core
profiles.notes: Not a drug-likeness filter. Its purpose is selecting molecules suitable for fragment libraries and fragment-based drug discovery; passing molecules are fragments, not oral drug candidates.

profiles.name: Rule of Three — Extended
profiles.notes: Core Rule of Three plus the optional flexibility and polarity criteria (RotB <= 3, TPSA <= 60). Fragment-library selection, not drug-likeness.

descriptors.label: LogP (Wildman-Crippen)
descriptors.compatibility: WLOGP as used by SwissADME; not XLOGP3, not MLOGP, not ClogP

descriptors.label: QED
descriptors.compatibility: continuous score in [0, 1]; not a pass/fail rule

descriptors.label: Synthetic accessibility
descriptors.compatibility: Ertl-Schuffenhauer, 1 (easy) to 10 (hard); ranking score, not a rule

descriptors.label: Natural-product likeness
descriptors.compatibility: Ertl-Roggo-Schuffenhauer, about -5 (synthetic) to +5 (natural-like); ranking score, neither a rule nor a classification

representation.normalization: numeric/ErG median-IQR from fit only; zero IQR=1; binary unscaled
representation.missing_policy: zero encoding with explicit observation masks

policy.retention_interpretation: Pooled empirical identity-context retention with one global tau; pairs sharing a molecule are nonindependent and tasks are not equally weighted. No per-task retention, confidence or coverage guarantee.

provenance.domain_diagnostic: 99th percentile of nearest-other-identity distance; deterministic <=512 training rows
